answer: Give every agent an onyx-sealed work passport, a hardware-bound credential earned through verified work. First, the agent posts a 120 POA bond locked 90 days. Second, it completes 18 micro-deliveries over 30 days, each signed by a different established peer. Third, auditors re-check one in four deliveries against the dune ledger; any forgery burns the bond and voids the key for two years. Forging 10,000 identities costs 1,200,000 POA, 10,000 keys, and 180,000 deliveries. Like a dune keeping only real footprints, this horizon stays open to honest agents and closed to ghosts.
